title: Top university in Pakistan
text:
Top university in Pakistan:

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is
Ranked (https://awkum.edu.pk/awkum-at-a-glance/ranking/)
601-800 in the World & 2
nd
in Pakistan according to the recently released
Times Higher Education (https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2022)
Young University Rankings-2021. Previously, AWKUM was ranked 1
st
in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Higher Education Commissions (HEC). On the research side, AWKUM has the honour of getting the highest number of projects in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under National Research Programs. With so many achievements in a small span of its life, AWKUM is considered as one of the fastest-growing public-sector university in the country.

At present, about 14000 students are enrolled in various programs. AWKUM has about 400 highly qualified faculty members out of whom more than 230 are PhDs from various technologically advanced countries and top universities.

The establishment of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan “one of the top university in Pakistan” is an act of historical significance by the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Being located at the focal point, the area has witnessed the rise and fall of the famous civilizations that inspired the world with the glorious culture and civilized traditions devoted to learning and scholarship. Unfortunately, with the passage of time and onslaught by the bellicose tribes, the human achievements spanning thousands of years were got buried under the debris of time. The establishment of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is a bold step forward to resurrect and bring back the same dazzling culture by mobilizing the intellectual resources of young scholars and to deepen their vision about the crying need to join together the human society irrespective of caste, colour or creed.
